sloka: सन्तुष्टपञ्चवर्गो ऽहं लोकयात्रां प्रवर्त्तये ।अकुह: श्रद्दधानस्सन् कार्य्याकार्य्यविचक्षण: ॥ २.१०९.२७॥

translations.english: I shall spend the term of my forest life with faith and holiness and purity of mind and with regulated food and with ancestors and gods satisfied with offerings of roots, flowers and fruits, with my five senses contented and with a mind that discriminates between what ought to be done and what ought not to be done.
